content.expected_result: Each mapped assertion yields its stated observable result. Definition coverage is separate from execution, automation and delivery proof.
preconditions: Use a disposable Saga/source fixture or an authorized staging environment; restore the fixture between independent assertion steps.
This is a proposed verification definition, not a recorded execution or assertion that planned hosting exists.

steps.action: In a fresh isolated scenario: Have the same human author a direct action on one slide and delegate an AI action on another; inspect both.
steps.expected_result: The direct action identifies the human actor, while only the delegated action carries the AI reviewer identity; sharing a principal does not merge the seats.

steps.action: In a fresh isolated scenario: Record two AI actions on behalf of the same human using different agent/model identities, then reload attribution.
steps.expected_result: Each action retains its own AI identity and human principal; the shared human does not collapse the two AI identities.
